localEvidence.excerpt:
runs-on: ${{ inputs.xcode == '26.6' && inputs.runner_arch == 'intel' && 'macos-26-intel' || (inputs.xcode == '26.6' || inputs.xcode == '27') && 'macos-26' || 'macos-15' }}
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Select and report SDK (never infer support from documentation alone)
        env:
          REQUESTED_XCODE: ${{ inputs.xcode || '26.3' }}
        run: |
          developer_dir="/Applications/Xcode_${REQUESTED_XCODE}.app/Contents/Developer"
          if [ ! -d "$developer_dir" ]; then
            echo "::error::Requested Xcode is not installed on this runner. Choose a compatible runner; iOS27 validation has NOT passed."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=$developer_dir" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          DEVELOPER_DIR="$developer_dir" xcodebuild -version
          DEVELOPER_DIR="$developer_dir" xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-version
      - name: Verify pinned offline depth model
